name: Otome no Higeki wa Zankoku na Kiss
original_name: 乙女の悲劇は残酷なキス
source:
As if losing her beloved cat wasn't sad enough, while returning home in despair she was kidnapped by a middle aged man. 

Why was she kidnapped? 
Why was she in this pitiful situation? 
Why was she starting to like it? 

A tale of sad, lonely love blossoming in captivity.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE069690.html]DLsite English[/url]]
